title: ECS Fargate network sent error rate exceeds threshold
description: Network sent error rate is the share of sent packets that failed. This monitor divides the per-second rate of the cumulative `ecs.fargate.net.sent_errors` counter by the sent packet rate per task and interface, so errors counted once at task start do not keep it alerting.

definition.name: [ECS Fargate] Network sent error rate is high for task: {{task_arn.name}} in service: {{ecs_service.name}}
definition.message:
Task {{task_arn.name}} of ECS Fargate service {{ecs_service.name}} in cluster {{ecs_cluster_name.name}} has a network sent error rate of {{value}}% on interface {{interface.name}}, which exceeds the 5% threshold.

This indicates potential network connectivity issues. To investigate further, view the affected service in the [ECS Explorer](/orchestration/explorer/ecsService?query=ecs_service:{{ecs_service.name}}+ecs_cluster:{{ecs_cluster_name.name}})
